title: potentilla cinerea var. incana
intro: Potentilla cinerea var. incana, commonly known as the downy cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, fever reduction, and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Potentilla cinerea var. incana include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain, and boost the immune system, making it a valuable natural remedy for overall well-being.
